summary: Underwater Cities is a tight Vladimír Suchý card-placement engine builder where you slot cards into colored action tracks to gain resources, build tunnels and domes, and unlock research, all while racing the clock across three eras. Every card you take also becomes part of a growing network that scores at the end, so early choices about what to build and where compound over the whole game.
praised: low direct luck once you understand the systems
high replayability from varied card pool
criticised: steep learning curve for new euro players
harsh negative scoring for undeveloped tunnel slots

interaction.kind: competition for shared action slots and cards
interaction.detail: Players compete for a limited number of colored slots along the shared card row and for special action spaces on the main board, so timing and denial matter, but each player otherwise develops their own underwater city network independently.

subsystems: special-project card resolution (each card scores by its own printed condition)
underwater city network building (domes + tunnels) for connection bonuses
sources: VP printed on special project cards as played
end-game bonus tiles for network/dome-tunnel completion
final scoring cards revealed at game end
unused action cards left in hand (small penalty)
scoring.how_you_win: Over 6 rounds, place cards into matching colored action slots to build domes, tunnels and special projects, then total all VP from cards played, network completion bonuses, and the certificate track at game end.
